svg.title: Ananya receives an urgent patient despite two conflicting records.
svg.desc: The stretcher crosses Rook Clinic's open doors as Ananya checks the patient's breathing and pulse. Riju holds the rejected terminal, Babul-da clears the paper queue, and Ananya orders the emergency reserve brought immediately.
